notes:
お{手伝|てつだ}い is the polite form of ⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧, with the honorific prefix お.

Sense 1 (help/assistance):
- お{手伝|てつだ}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to help - polite)
- お{手伝|てつだ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (same meaning)

Sense 2 (housemaid):
- Usually referred to as お{手伝|てつだ}いさん with the respectful suffix さん
- This usage is somewhat dated; modern terms include ⟦{家政婦|かせいふ}→家政婦：12496_kaseifu⟧ or ハウスキーパー

For children, helping with household chores is called お{手伝|てつだ}い, an important concept in Japanese family education.
